en.headline: CHP to end free hepatitis A vaccine for MSM from 12 September
en.dek: The Centre for Health Protection said the transmission chain linked to a cluster among men who have sex with men has been interrupted and cases have returned to baseline levels.
body: The Centre for Health Protection announced that free hepatitis A vaccination for men who have sex with men will stop on 12 September. The online booking platform will cease accepting new appointments from 11 September.

The centre launched the free two-dose programme in mid-March after identifying a cluster of genetically identical hepatitis A cases between September 2025 and February 2026, more than 60 per cent of which involved men who have sex with men. More than 280 people had been vaccinated by the end of July.

Cases among the group have since fallen to low levels. Genetic analysis showed no further matches with the earlier cluster sequence after June. Individuals who received the first dose but cannot complete the second before 12 September will be notified of alternative arrangements.

zh.headline: 男男性接觸者免費甲肝疫苗接種安排9月12日停止
zh.dek: 衞生防護中心指涉及男男性接觸者的甲型肝炎群組傳播鏈已截斷，個案回落至基線水平，免費接種安排將於9月12日結束。
body: 衞生署衞生防護中心宣布，為男男性接觸者提供的免費甲型肝炎疫苗接種安排將於9月12日停止，網上預約平台由9月11日起停止接受新預約。
中心自3月中旬起為男男性接觸者提供兩劑免費疫苗，以應對2025年9月至2026年2月期間發現的基因序列相同甲型肝炎感染群組。截至7月31日已為超過280人接種。
過去數月涉及男男性接觸者的個案持續下跌至低水平，6月後再無發現與早前群組序列相同的個案。已接種第一劑但未能於9月12日前完成第二劑的合資格人士，中心會個別通知第二劑接種安排。
